# Configure metered usage billing

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When a product charges based on measured consumption, credits or contract-specific usage commitments. A reviewed billing specification with reproducible meter-to-invoice tests and controlled production activation.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Specify the billable events and customer identity

agent-runnable


Define units, event timestamps, customer identifiers, aggregation windows and excluded activity. Describe duplicate, late and missing events so engineers and finance share one billing specification.

- Sources: [Stripe usage-based billing](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Approve pricing and contractual treatment

human · human approval required · hard to undo


The commercial owner and advisers approve rates, commitments, credit expiry treatment and dispute handling for applicable contracts. Resolve uncertain terms before accepting billable usage.

- Sources: [Stripe usage-based billing](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Prepare a reproducible usage test dataset

agent-runnable


Build fictional events for normal use, duplicates, late arrival, corrections and customer changes. Calculate expected quantities and charges independently from the provider output.

- Sources: [Stripe usage-based billing](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Configure approved meters and billing rules

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


Authorized operators apply reviewed settings in a test environment using the provider currently supported integration. Preserve versioned event schemas and avoid creating real charges during configuration.

- Sources: [Stripe usage-based billing](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Verify quantities and customer-visible invoices

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Engineering and finance compare events, aggregations, credits and invoice previews to independent expectations. Block launch on unexplained differences or inability to trace a charge back to usage.

- Sources: [Stripe usage-based billing](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Authorize production billing and monitor exceptions

manual form/portal · human approval required · hard to undo


The accountable owner approves production activation. Authorized operators enable the reviewed configuration, monitor missing events and reconcile invoices; refunds or corrective charges require scoped approval.

- Verify: A reviewed billing specification with reproducible meter-to-invoice tests and controlled production activation.
- Sources: [Stripe usage-based billing](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/usage-based)
